Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 8 pack code 960EX.

The Robus Ultimum Express Flat LED downlight is a versatile lighting solution, offering dual wattage at 4W or 5.8W and CCT selectable colour temperatures of 3000K, 4000K, or 6000K. This fire rated downlight is ideal for electricians and installers working on domestic and commercial projects, including bathroom installations due to its IP65 rating. It features a shallow 46mm depth and a 60mm cut-out, making installation straightforward in various ceiling voids. The integrated LED provides a long 50,000 hour life, reducing maintenance, while its dimmable function allows for adjustable light levels. Fire rated to 30, 60, and 90 minutes, for compliance and safety.
